access_instructions.public_arm_inputs: Fetch the eight monomer sources, check supplied bytes and SHA-256, then generate the prepared files as documented.
access_instructions.evaluator_private_inputs: Only downstream fetch_private.sh fetches the four native complexes at the published URLs recorded per input; verify bytes and SHA-256 and store at reference.name under CMP_PRIVATE. Setup and arms must not fetch, copy or read them.

software_inputs.private_data: for each input, the native complex named in spec.reference, fetched by fetch_private.sh from its URL and checked against its SHA-256 and byte count. fetch_private.sh is self-contained: it carries each input's reference name, URL, byte count and SHA-256 in its own text and reads no other file under harness/, because only the sealed comparison files and the usual harness scripts are uploaded to the box.
software_inputs.reads: the model_<rank>.pdb files under CMP_ARM_OUT, in rank order; the native complex under CMP_PRIVATE at the name, byte count and SHA-256 given by spec.reference in CMP_INPUT_SPEC
software_inputs.invocation: BiotiteDockQ is constructed with parallel_io=False (models read in the evaluator's own process). evaluate.sh is self-contained: it carries the evaluator's Python program in its own text, writes it at each call to a regular file under CMP_EVAL_OUT, and runs it as the venv interpreter followed by that file's path. It never runs a program read from standard input (PINDER's parallel reader starts its workers with the spawn method, which re-imports the main program from its file) and never runs or reads any other file under harness/, which is not uploaded to the box.
software_inputs.writes: CMP_EVAL_OUT/dockq.json, one JSON array of the DockQ values in rank order and no other number; any per-model detail goes to a separate file under CMP_EVAL_OUT

splits: Exactly four holo test-set fixture pairs in comparison_view.json. No training, no original apo cases, no full dataset download.

resources.reason: Only required fixture source bytes are known; peak CPU/GPU FFT working set and evaluator memory are not published for these cases. Full PINDER corpus is not required.

generated_inputs: Eight prepared PDBs generated by the specified chain-field-only transformation; fifty assembled model PDBs per scheduled arm invocation generated by published decoygen and view assembly commands.
